name: Cao Cuifen
bio: Cao Cuifen (born 6 April 1944) is a Chinese actress. She is best known for her performance in the film Raise the Red Lantern.

credits.title: If I Were You
credits.overview: After saving a woman from a love crisis, two strangers agree to make decisions for each other, leading to unexpected life changes while hiding a secret that torments them between lies and truth.

credits.title: Back to the South
credits.overview: After drifting in Beijing for many years, Lin Shanshan returned to her hometown in the south and transformed the old house she once lived in with her grandmother into a homestay. Here, she experienced four wonderful and heartwarming stories with her guests.

credits.title: Love is Not Blind
credits.overview: Xiaoxian's life falls apart when she discovers her boyfriend is cheating on her with her best friend. Heartbroken, she struggles to move on, but her tough co-worker Jian steps in with a tough-love approach to help her heal.

credits.title: Six Sisters in the War
credits.overview: Set in a Shandong village during the crucial Menglianggu Campaign between communists and nationalists in 1947, the film follows six women from various families as the (largely offscreen) civil war impacts their feudal existence.

credits.title: Seven Nights
credits.overview: Chinese horror film directed by Zhang Jing.

credits.title: Raise the Red Lantern
credits.overview: In 1920s China, 19-year-old Songlian becomes a concubine of a powerful lord and is forced to compete with his three wives for the privileges gained.

credits.title: The Young Teacher
credits.overview: A drama about a teacher and the students she teaches.

credits.title: Three Black Triangles
credits.overview: The Public Security Bureau intercept a telegram notifying foreign agents to retrieve the "110 secret". Shi Yan, head of the Reconnaissance Section, starts a campaign of counter-espionage, but one of his agents is soon killed on board a train.
